title: IMPORTANT INFORMATION
paragraphs: CSOP Hang Seng TECH Index ETF is a passive exchange traded fund that is not principal guaranteed, and your investments may suffer losses. Investment in the Product may also involve risks, including but not limited to equity market risk, new index risk, risks related to companies with a technology theme, geographical concentration risk, reliance on market makers risk, differences in dealing arrangements between Listed and Unlisted Class of Units risk, tracking error risk, trading risk and risk of early termination.

Investment involves risks. Investors should refer to the offering documents and product key facts statement of the Fund for further details, including the product features and risk factors. The past performance information presented is not indicative of future performance.
